description:
Register a new custom Coordinate Reference System (CRS) in GeoServer and publish a reprojected layer. 

1. Log in to the GeoServer web admin at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (User: admin, Password: Admin123!).
2. Navigate to 'Data > SRS List' and create a new SRS with Code '990001'.
3. Use the following WKT for the description:
   PROJCS["Pacific Mercator", 
     GEOGCS["WGS 84", 
       DATUM["World Geodetic System 1984", 
         SPHEROID["WGS 84", 6378137.0, 298.257223563]], 
       PRIMEM["Greenwich", 0.0], 
       UNIT["degree", 0.017453292519943295], 
       AXIS["Geodetic longitude", EAST], 
       AXIS["Geodetic latitude", NORTH]], 
     PROJECTION["Mercator_1SP"], 
     PARAMETER["central_meridian", 150.0], 
     PARAMETER["latitude_of_origin", 0.0], 
     PARAMETER["scale_factor", 1.0], 
     PARAMETER["false_easting", 0.0], 
     PARAMETER["false_northing", 0.0], 
     UNIT["m", 1.0], 
     AXIS["Easting", EAST], 
     AXIS["Northing", NORTH], 
     AUTHORITY["EPSG","990001"]]

4. Create a new layer in the 'ne' workspace named 'ne_countries_pacific' using the 'ne_countries' table from the 'postgis_ne' store.
5. Configure the layer to use 'EPSG:990001' as the Declared SRS and set SRS Handling to 'Reproject native to declared'.
6. Compute the bounding boxes and save.
